title: 门店改造要花钱，怎样说明顾客为什么值得？
topic: 用顾客体验和经营指标解释门店投入的价值

source.title: How Target Is Transforming Stores to Better Serve Guests
source.section: How Target Is Transforming Stores to Better Serve Guests
source.type: Target 官方门店改造与顾客体验案例
source.context: Target 官方业务材料；本课练习围绕实际业务沟通任务。
paragraphs: Target is ramping up the pace of its remodels this year, bringing our elevated shopping experience to more guests. It’s a bigger transformation for our stores than at any point in the past decade, with updated layouts that are easier to navigate and discover the best of Target’s style, design and value.

What's fueling this transformation? Our belief that our stores are the heart of Target and one of our biggest differentiators. They provide a stage for our differentiated offerings — including exclusive collaborations and only-at-Target items — and power our same-day fulfillment services.

That’s why we’re investing approximately $5 billion this year toward 130-plus remodels and 30 new stores, as well as updates in technology and our supply chain. And the pace of our remodels will continue, as we invest in our stores to meet changing guest expectations.

“These investments are all about making Target an even easier, more inspiring and friendly place to shop,” says Laurie Mahowald, senior vice president, Target Properties. “We’re evolving our stores in ways that reflect how guests shop today — from more intuitive layouts to expanded assortments — while also strengthening the role our stores play in fulfillment and our long-term growth.”
Each Target remodel is designed with guests in mind — for a more intuitive, inspiring and convenient shopping experience. In many locations, this includes:

Updated spaces and expanded services to support Order Pickup, Drive Up and Exchanges & Returns, along with updates to our traditional checkout and Express Self-Checkout lanes to improve their flow and convenience.

By enhancing our in-store experience, we’re also creating a more seamless connection between digital and physical — letting guests shop however they choose. With 76% of U.S. households within 10 miles of a Target store, our physical locations not only offer opportunities for guests to discover our exclusive, on-trend assortment. They also support our fast, flexible fulfillment services like Drive Up, Order Pickup and same-day and next-day shipping.

Ultimately, our stores are not just places to shop — they are critical infrastructure that powers speed, scale and long-term growth across the business. Case in point: Our remodeled stores typically see a low- to mid-single-digit sales lift, along with higher traffic and more guest engagement.
translations: Target 今年正在加快门店改造步伐，让更多顾客享受到升级后的购物体验。门店改造规模超过过去十年任何时候，更新后的布局让顾客更容易逛店，也更容易发现 Target 在风格、设计和价值方面的优势。
推动这项转型的是什么？我们相信门店是 Target 的核心，也是最大的差异化优势之一。门店既展示独家合作和 Target 专有商品等差异化产品，也支撑当日履约服务。
因此，我们今年计划投入约 50 亿美元，用于 130 多家门店改造和 30 家新店，以及技术和供应链更新。我们会继续改造门店，以满足顾客不断变化的期待。
Target Properties 高级副总裁 Laurie Mahowald 说：“这些投资都是为了让 Target 成为更方便、更有启发性、更友好的购物场所。我们正在根据顾客当下的购物方式改造门店，从更直观的布局到扩大的商品组合，同时强化门店在履约和长期增长中的作用。”
每家 Target 门店改造都以顾客为中心，目标是让购物体验更直观、更有启发性、更方便。在许多门店，这包括：
更新后的空间和扩展的服务将支持订单自取、Drive Up 车边取货、换货与退货，同时改造传统收银和快速自助结账通道，以改善通行效率和便利度。
通过改善店内体验，我们也在打造线上与线下更顺畅的连接，让顾客按自己喜欢的方式购物。美国有 76% 的家庭住在距离 Target 门店 10 英里范围内。实体门店不仅让顾客发现独家、流行的商品，也支持 Drive Up、订单自取以及当日和次日配送等快速、灵活的履约服务。
归根结底，我们的门店不只是购物场所，也是支撑全公司速度、规模和长期增长的关键基础设施。一个例子是：改造后的门店通常能带来低个位数至中个位数的销售提升，以及更高的客流和顾客参与度。
fullTextParagraphs: Target is ramping up the pace of its remodels this year, bringing our elevated shopping experience to more guests. It’s a bigger transformation for our stores than at any point in the past decade, with updated layouts that are easier to navigate and discover the best of Target’s style, design and value.

What's fueling this transformation? Our belief that our stores are the heart of Target and one of our biggest differentiators. They provide a stage for our differentiated offerings — including exclusive collaborations and only-at-Target items — and power our same-day fulfillment services.

That’s why we’re investing approximately $5 billion this year toward 130-plus remodels and 30 new stores, as well as updates in technology and our supply chain. And the pace of our remodels will continue, as we invest in our stores to meet changing guest expectations.

“These investments are all about making Target an even easier, more inspiring and friendly place to shop,” says Laurie Mahowald, senior vice president, Target Properties. “We’re evolving our stores in ways that reflect how guests shop today — from more intuitive layouts to expanded assortments — while also strengthening the role our stores play in fulfillment and our long-term growth.”
Each Target remodel is designed with guests in mind — for a more intuitive, inspiring and convenient shopping experience. In many locations, this includes:

An expanded dry grocery selection, as well as everyday essentials and pantry staples. Some locations will also get larger fresh and frozen food sections, making Target an even more convenient, one-stop destination.
Modern décor and fixtures and specialty LED lighting to create a shopping experience that is both hip and cool, warm and inviting, with new signage to navigate the store easily and quickly.
Engaging merchandise displays throughout the store — including in apparel and accessories, beauty and home — to highlight our elevated style.

Updated spaces and expanded services to support Order Pickup, Drive Up and Exchanges & Returns, along with updates to our traditional checkout and Express Self-Checkout lanes to improve their flow and convenience.
Modernized guest amenities including restrooms along with designated nursing spaces.
In select locations, Target is introducing natural refrigeration systems, more efficient lighting and HVAC systems that not only help reduce emissions but also energy costs.

This remodel effort is happening as we’re leveling up the assortment in key categories across the sales floor like health and wellness, beauty, baby, home and women’s style, with thoughtfully curated items in expanded, dedicated spaces.

By enhancing our in-store experience, we’re also creating a more seamless connection between digital and physical — letting guests shop however they choose. With 76% of U.S. households within 10 miles of a Target store, our physical locations not only offer opportunities for guests to discover our exclusive, on-trend assortment. They also support our fast, flexible fulfillment services like Drive Up, Order Pickup and same-day and next-day shipping.

Ultimately, our stores are not just places to shop — they are critical infrastructure that powers speed, scale and long-term growth across the business. Case in point: Our remodeled stores typically see a low- to mid-single-digit sales lift, along with higher traffic and more guest engagement.

Together, Target’s investments in remodels and new stores reflect a long-term commitment to growth — one rooted in making everyday life that much more inspiring and convenient for busy families across the U.S.
We’re here to help all families discover the joy of everyday life through digital discovery and exceptional in-store experiences.

scenario.title: 模拟情境：区域负责人要求评估门店改造
english: Guests say it is hard to find popular items and checkout lines move slowly.
The region is considering a store remodel that would update layouts, checkout, and pickup areas.
Explain how the changes address guest needs and how the team should measure the results after launch.
chinese: 顾客反馈热门商品不好找，结账排队也慢。
区域团队正在考虑改造门店布局、结账区和取货区。
请说明改造如何回应顾客需求，并提出上线后如何衡量结果。

firstAttempt.prompt: 顾客反映商品不好找、结账等待时间长。请用英语说明门店改造如何回应这两个问题，并提出顾客体验和运营方面的复盘指标。
firstAttempt.sample: The remodel should meet changing guest expectations by making key items easier to find and improving flow and convenience at checkout. Updated pickup and returns areas can also support same-day fulfillment. After launch, we should review sales lift and guest engagement by store, along with checkout wait time and pickup completion.
firstAttempt.rationale: 把布局和结账改造分别对应顾客问题，再用顾客体验和运营数据检验效果。

words.example: The store remodel will update the layout and checkout area.
words.translation: 门店改造将更新布局和结账区。
words.note: 可指建筑、门店或空间的翻新改造。

words.example: The remodel will support same-day fulfillment services.
words.translation: 门店改造将支持当日履约服务。
words.note: 此处指门店拣货、取货和配送等订单交付环节。

words.example: The team will compare sales lift across remodeled stores.
words.translation: 团队会比较改造门店的销售提升幅度。
words.note: 衡量销售变化时，应同时核对时间段和比较基准。

taskPhrases.meaning: 满足顾客不断变化的期待
taskPhrases.example: The new layout should meet changing guest expectations.
taskPhrases.translation: 新布局应满足顾客不断变化的期待。

taskPhrases.meaning: 改善流转效率和便利度
taskPhrases.example: The checkout update should improve flow and convenience.
taskPhrases.translation: 结账区更新应改善通行效率和便利度。

taskPhrases.word: review sales lift and guest engagement by store
taskPhrases.meaning: 复盘销售提升和顾客参与度
taskPhrases.collocation: review + sales lift / guest engagement, by store
taskPhrases.example: After the remodel, we should review sales lift and guest engagement by store.
taskPhrases.translation: 门店改造后，我们应按门店复盘销售提升和顾客参与度。

structure.original: Our remodeled stores typically see a low- to mid-single-digit sales lift, along with higher traffic and more guest engagement.
analysis: typically see 表示通常观察到的结果，不是每家门店的保证。
sales lift、higher traffic 和 more guest engagement 并列呈现经营变化。
比较改造效果时，要用改造前后或相似门店作基准。
structure.transfer: The updated pickup area typically reduces wait time and improves order completion across busy stores.

rewrite.bad: We should remodel the store because new stores look better.
rewrite.good: The remodel should meet changing guest expectations by making key items easier to find and improving flow and convenience at checkout. Updated pickup and returns areas can support same-day fulfillment. After launch, we should review sales lift and guest engagement by store against the pre-remodel baseline.
rewrite.translation: 门店改造应通过让顾客更容易找到重点商品、改善结账区域的流转效率和便利度，来满足顾客不断变化的期待。更新取货和退货区域也能支持当日履约。上线后，我们应按门店对照改造前基线，复盘销售提升和顾客参与度。
rewrite.pattern: The change should make [task] easier and improve [experience]. After launch, we will compare [measure] with the baseline.

cloze.prompt: The new layout is designed to meet changing guest ______.
cloze.why: guest expectations 指顾客对购物体验的期待。

cloze.prompt: The checkout update should improve flow and ______.
cloze.why: flow and convenience 描述结账顺畅度和便利度。

cloze.prompt: We should review sales lift and guest ______ by store.
cloze.why: guest engagement 指顾客参与和互动情况。

dictation.label: 听写 1
dictation.text: These investments are all about making Target an even easier, more inspiring and friendly place to shop.
dictation.why: 留意 easier、more inspiring 和 friendly 三项体验描述。

apply.sample: Remodeled stores typically see higher traffic and more guest engagement.

dictation.label: 听写 2
dictation.text: Updated checkout lanes will improve their flow and convenience.
dictation.why: 听出 flow and convenience 是结账区的改善目标。

apply.prompt: 我们会把等待时间和顾客反馈与改造前基线比较。
apply.sample: We will compare wait time and guest feedback with the baseline.

translationPractice.prompt: 新布局应满足顾客不断变化的期待。
translationPractice.answer: The new layout should meet changing guest expectations.
translationPractice.why: meet expectations 表示满足顾客期待。

translationPractice.prompt: 结账区更新应改善通行效率和便利度。
translationPractice.answer: The checkout update should improve flow and convenience.
translationPractice.why: flow and convenience 描述结账是否顺畅方便。

translationPractice.prompt: 门店改造后，我们应按门店复盘销售提升和顾客参与度。
translationPractice.answer: After the remodel, we should review sales lift and guest engagement by store.
translationPractice.why: by store 表示按门店分别复盘结果。

choice.prompt: 改造后某家门店销售额上升，但同期客流也增加。要判断改造是否有效，哪种复盘方式更合适？
options: Attribute all sales growth to the remodel without checking a baseline.
Compare similar periods and stores, then review sales lift, wait time, and guest feedback together.
Use sales only and ignore the guest experience.
choice.why: 与基线和相似门店比较，并同时看顾客体验与运营指标，能减少把其他变化误认为改造效果的风险。

output.prompt: 向区域负责人说明门店改造预算。请说清改造回应的顾客问题、对履约的帮助，以及上线后要追踪的指标。
output.sample: The remodel should meet changing guest expectations by making key items easier to find and improving flow and convenience at checkout. Updated pickup and returns areas can support same-day fulfillment. After launch, we should review sales lift and guest engagement by store against the pre-remodel baseline.
check: 把改造措施与顾客问题对应起来
说明店内服务如何支持订单履约
提出上线后的运营与顾客指标
